name: Kitajima Youko
source:
A beautiful, busty wife who runs a café with her husband, a former top-tier trading company executive who left his corporate job.

Having known nothing but sex with her aloof husband, her sexual desire is practically nonexistent.

She decides to star in adult videos to pay off her debts, but this experience awakens her carnal desires, and she finds herself at the mercy of fate.
